title: Read exact Project category paid and invoicing-unpaid segments offline with recognized value derived once

requirements.invariant: Each category exposes two exact signed semantic amounts: client paid and invoicing/unpaid. Recognized Project progress is derived only as client paid plus invoicing/unpaid and is never independently caller-authored.

An equal category amount moving from invoicing/unpaid to client paid during collection leaves recognized progress unchanged. Neither an Invoice link nor the collection Purchase face amount can add a second contribution in this read contract.

The segment contract is currency-safe and accepts signed values, including zero and negative amounts, without choosing visual colors, bar direction, labels, clamping, percentages, credit settlement, or any other behavior controlled by O-003 through O-005 or O-010.

The target segment boundary replaces Transaction-only arithmetic and cached Firebase budgetSummary authority with one exact Account/Project/currency request and category snapshots using stable category identity and definition order. It does not decide contribution-source eligibility or construct the complete ProjectBudgetSnapshot.

One narrow ProjectBudgetSegmentQuerying port watches a typed request bound to exact AccountID, ProjectID and CurrencyCode and returns only matching segment snapshots; it exposes no generic financial query, provider DTO, mutation, contribution resolver or authorization decision.

Ready, authoritative-empty, incomplete partial, stale and failed local reads remain distinct and carry both LocalDataVersion and accounting-authority/projection revision. Cross-Account, currency-mismatched, duplicate, hidden-count, overflowed, malformed or rebound evidence fails atomically through stable bounded diagnostics; local values never grant current financial authorization.

This Phase 1 boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free synthetic evidence while the shipped Firebase app remains unchanged. It creates no contribution, Invoice, Transaction, budget row, schema/RLS/Sync policy, Auth/provider adapter, app/MCP wiring, source transform, hosted resource, migration or production authority.

items: ProjectBudgetSegmentRequest binds one exact AccountID, ProjectID and CurrencyCode to a deterministic versioned query fingerprint.

ProjectBudgetCategorySegment carries one BudgetCategoryDefinitionSnapshot, signed clientPaid and invoicingUnpaid Money in the request currency, and encoded recognized evidence that is derived and verified as their overflow-safe sum rather than accepted from a caller.

ProjectBudgetSegmentSnapshot validates finite local time, exact request fingerprint, nonzero accounting-authority/projection revision, category Account/currency scope, visible count, unique category identity and presentation order, then canonicalizes rows by category definition order and stable ID.
ProjectBudgetSegmentQuerying exposes only watchProjectBudgetSegments(_:). ProjectBudgetSegmentFailure supplies stable bounded scope/currency/duplicate/count/time/arithmetic/read/encoding diagnostics.

items: The request, rows and snapshot are canonical Codable evidence over stable scope/category identity, signed Money, LocalDataVersion, accounting-authority/projection revision and ListLocalSnapshot readiness; decoding reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Equivalent input canonicalizes by category presentation order and stable ID. Malformed, rebound or internally inconsistent scope/currency/identity/order/count/readiness/recognized evidence fails atomically; partial absence never becomes authoritative empty.

A deterministic reference adapter may stream exact request-matching snapshots and bounded local failure; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, authenticated Sync, current authorization or contribution-source evidence.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot authorize, resolve, persist, present or synchronize contributions; calculate budget limits/remaining/over/source counts; mutate an Invoice/Transaction; define schema/RLS/Sync/provider/migration behavior; activate a feature; deploy, release or cut over.

O-003 through O-010, O-015, O-026, O-033 through O-036 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-016 remain outside this boundary. Physical offline verification, canonical production profiling and all hosted-resource authority remain gated.

verification.expected: Synthetic categories preserve exact signed client-paid and invoicing/unpaid Money, derive recognized once with overflow safety, and prove an equal collection segment exchange leaves recognized unchanged without an Invoice/Transaction/source/provider field.

Ready, authoritative-empty, partial and stale exact-scope snapshots plus equivalent reordered input round-trip byte-identically with category order, signed values, derived recognized, completeness, LocalDataVersion, accounting-authority/projection revision and finite as-of evidence; empty incomplete snapshots never mean authoritative zero.

Cross-Account, currency-mismatched, duplicate category identity/order, hidden-count, nonfinite-time, incomplete-as-authoritative, arithmetic-overflow, malformed-derived and rebound request/snapshot evidence fails atomically through stable bounded diagnostics.

A deterministic reference port streams only the exact Account/Project/currency request, refuses rebound or mismatched snapshots, stops delivery on cancellation and surfaces upstream failure without a false snapshot, cross-scope fallback, authorization, contribution resolution or false completeness.

notes: Ready decision-independent Phase 1 query boundary. Canonical Budget Progress and D-012 settle the exact signed paid/unpaid meanings, derived sum and no-change-on-collection invariant while explicitly leaving visual treatment open. The slice carries no source-kind or contribution eligibility, budget limit/remaining/over/source count, Invoice/Transaction command, negative-credit presentation, Postgres/RLS/PowerSync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, migration, hosted-resource, production or cutover behavior. O-005 therefore remains open rather than being selected by this nonvisual semantic read contract. Exact ready commit 43189f1abe6e023f4d29b00f190b40464ce7a3e5 passed immutable Actions run 33687191592. The second write-capable subagent pilot must start from that commit and remains subject to complete integration-agent line review, independent adversarial review, full local gates and exact integrated-commit CI.
